process_boundary.statement: The audit did not launch, attach to, automate, or call the pre-existing ETABS process. Process observation, registry reads, file hashing, reflection, and type-library wrapper generation were read-only with respect to ETABS and every model.

comtypes_shape_runtime.default_outer_multi_output_container: list when one or more [in,out] parameters and more than one output are present
comtypes_shape_runtime.shape_limit: The generated shape is proved for the inspected comtypes 1.4.16 implementation and metadata. Actual live values, return codes, array lengths, and any provider/context drift still require installed-session observation.

metadata_conventions.com_method_return: Every inspected generated COM method returns HRESULT at the transport layer. comtypes raises transport failures rather than exposing HRESULT as a normal Python result.
metadata_conventions.native_return_code: Where pRetVal is LONG, it is the CSI API return code. With other [in,out] outputs, comtypes 1.4.16 returns it as the final list item; with SetPresentUnits it is the direct scalar result.

precision_notes: LoadCases.GetNameList has an installed optional CaseType parameter after the two [in,out] values; its default 0 makes the existing no-argument W2A call correct.
Results.FrameForce requires ItemTypeElm; W2A correctly supplies 0 (ObjectElm), although the frozen display string resembles a defaulted argument.

The installed comtypes provider proves list-shaped outer multi-output values and tuple-shaped one-dimensional SAFEARRAY values by default. W2A intentionally accepts tuple or list at both validated boundaries, so it is a compatible superset.

non_operation_claims.claim: Exact model path/hash/size/timestamps, lock state, stories, frames, sections, topology, selections, statuses, force stations, dispositions, and deterministic baseline hashes for the copied model.

non_operation_claims.claim: Accepted/excluded/blocked topology and result dispositions with stable reason codes.
non_operation_claims.evidence: The W2A source freezes the exhaustive decision rules, but only installed model rows can exercise them.

w2c_installed_session_preflight: The user-authorized Windows campaign must first freeze, validate, commit, and push W2B. Phase C then requires the exact W2B head, this evidence plan, copied-model allowlist, result selections, workbook/output identities, and every remaining preflight condition. The static audit alone is not execution evidence.

Fetch GitHub and create a dedicated clean Windows evidence worktree from the exact approved candidate/merge. Prove branch/head/tree, source_bound=true, no Git operation, and no unrelated worktree overlap; protected Windows main remains HOLD_MAIN.

Require 64-bit Python 3.11, comtypes 1.4.16, ETABS 23.3.1.4563, the x64 ETABSv1 typelib LIBID/version above, and the exact typelib SHA-256 above. Any drift requires a new static audit before COM execution.

Use only the authorized copied absolute .edb path. Record a read-only pre-observation of path/name/SHA-256/bytes/modified UTC/observed UTC; require the model to be saved, locked, and byte-identical to the approved allowlist.
Launch ETABS/Excel only in the separately authorized installed session, at matching privilege. Abort on licensing, abnormal-condition, recovery, save, analysis, or other unexpected dialogs.
Confirm every requested case/combination is exact, already analyzed where applicable, already selected for output, and requires no selection setter. Record the explicit inventory before extraction.

Record GetPresentUnits before extraction, prove temporary enum 5 while reading, and require exact restoration by a final getter. Keep a manual unit-verification step available if an exception occurs before evidence is serialized.
Capture operation name, outer/inner Python container types, decoded output count/order, array counts, and CSI return code for every frozen call without recording proprietary model contents in Git.

Run the W2A extraction and later W2B direct/REST/Excel paths only as approved; reconcile canonical JSON hashes, stable IDs, dispositions, row counts, and every retained station. Keep full payloads/workbooks in the approved external evidence root and track only safe hashes/summaries.
Immediately after all reads, observe the model file again and prove identical path/hash/bytes/modified time with nondecreasing observation time; prove lock and original units are unchanged.
w2c_abort_criteria: Abort before COM access if the source head/tree, W2B approval, machine architecture, ETABS/comtypes version, typelib LIBID/version/path/hash, generated shape, or authorized evidence root differs from the approved preflight.

Abort if the open model is not the exact authorized copied .edb, is unsaved or unlocked, has a different hash/size/timestamp, or any application dialog requests recovery, save, analysis, design, licensing action, or abnormal-condition dismissal.

Abort on any missing method/property, unexpected argument binding, outer shape outside tuple/list, inner result array outside tuple/list, output-count/order mismatch, nonzero CSI return code, invalid direct scalar, or count/array mismatch.

Abort if present units are invalid, SetPresentUnits(5) returns nonzero, enum 5 cannot be proved during the run, restoration returns nonzero, or the final unit enum differs from the original. Verify model state manually before any retry.

Abort if any requested case/combination is absent, inactive for output, unfinished (case status not 4), or yields no retained FrameForce row for any accepted beam. Do not use result-selection setters.

Abort on duplicate/blank story or frame identities, a frame story outside GetStories, invalid endpoints/coordinates, incomplete connected topology, an unsupported connected frame, no accepted beam, more than 100000 force rows for one frame, member/result identity mismatch, or nonfinite result values.

Abort if the post-read model observation differs from the pre-read identity, lock state is false, original units are not restored, or reconciliation across approved direct/REST/Excel surfaces is not exact.

Abort if completion would require any setter other than temporary SetPresentUnits, or any analysis, design, unlock, save, model/workbook mutation, optimization, writeback, or disclosure of proprietary payloads.
limitations: This is a static installed-API audit, not a live ETABS model acceptance.
No runtime data value, CSI return-code value, result freshness, model identity, row inventory, unit restoration outcome, or application behavior was inferred from metadata.
Generated vendor wrapper code and proprietary model/workbook/result bytes are not committed or reproduced.
W2B transport/Excel implementation and W2C installed execution remain unstarted and separately gated.
Frame analysis remains HELD_NOT_SUPPORTED and qualified engineering review remains required.
